ModMetaData.name: RimMarket - Scorpion Compatibility Patch
ModMetaData.author: Community compatibility patch
ModMetaData.description:
Prevents the Vanilla Factions Expanded - Classical Scorpion from being selected or accepted as stock in RimMarket colony stalls.
This is a targeted workaround for the reported ingredient-search/reservation exception involving a Scorpion stored in a market stall. The weapon and turret remain available for normal use.
Before enabling: remove all Scorpions already stored in stalls and cancel their sale orders. Existing stock is not automatically moved.
Load after Harmony, RimMarket and Vanilla Factions Expanded - Classical.
Includes RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7 builds. Compiled and checked against RimMarket assemblies; gameplay reproduction in the affected save is still pending. Unofficial community patch.
